page.overview:
What is Time?

Time is a non-canon plane subtype featured in Doctor Who on the card Temple of Atropos.

Time is a planet that existed outside of time and space. It is artificial, created as part of the Time Lords' efforts to end the [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/Dark_Times Dark Times] and keep the [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/Anchoring_of_the_thread forces of time under control]. Its planetary mass was carefully calculated for its purpose and it contains the Temple of Atropos, home of the [https://tardis.fandom.com/wiki/Mouri Mouri] who control the flow of time.
